source_meta.name: CAPSTONE CA Strategy — HUF Gift Planning
source_meta.author: CAPSTONE tax brain

chunks.text: When a member gifts capital to the family HUF: document the transfer via HUF bank credit, reference the HUF deed, assess Section 64(2) clubbing on future income from gifted assets, and escalate if the gift funds income-producing assets.
Post-gift compliance: update Schedule AL where applicable, maintain board/karta resolution, separate HUF books, and model clubbing impact before routing future income through the HUF.
